description: GET ONLY the 'Item' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. Item catalogue — every consumable, equipment piece, resource, gear or generic inventory entity the player can own. Defines item IDs, names, categories, stack rules, rarities. Referenced by Store SKUs (as contents), Lootbox loot tables, Quest rewards, Craft recipes, and Reward payouts. For premium-tier bundles use Premium; for character entities use Character.
name: get_item
title: Get Item settings
